messages:
Tara (Eng): Follow-up from today's all-hands: can Private customers include Redwood logs in their SOC2 scope? Quick answers appreciated.

Maya (Security): Short: it's shared responsibility. Our SOC2 covers our control plane and managed services. For Private (VPC/on-prem) we provide a SOC2 mapping pack and evidence templates but customers are responsible for infra/network controls.

Owen (Product): We'll add a product note to the handbook: "How to integrate Redwood artifacts into customer SOC2 audits".

Tara (Eng): Also a question about KMS: can customers bring their own key for signing audit batches?

Maya (Security): Yes. BYOK supported for Private. We integrate with AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, and on-prem HSM via mTLS. We only store key references/grants, not key material.

Priya (Privacy): Note: long retention (>1 year) needs DSAR/region review. If a customer wants 7 years, loop legal/privacy early.

Tara (Eng): Any quick CLI sample to enable audit export to customer S3?

Maya (Security): Example:
```
redwoodctl export enable --dep dp-999 --target s3://cust-audit --format json --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/abcd
```
Ensure VPC endpoints and IAM grants first.
